source.evidenceType: Original sponsor announcement of EASD abstracts

assessment: Novo reported a 52-week fMRI/eating-behaviour study, a REIMAGINE 1 MRI sub-study in early type 2 diabetes and a post-hoc REIMAGINE 2 bone-marker analysis. These are distinct analyses, not a single trial or established fracture-prevention evidence. The release also states high-dose CagriSema 2.4 mg/7.2 mg Phase 3 began in 2026. The US FDA decision remains expected in Q4 2026; the expectation is not approval.
limitations: Detailed original abstracts and exact high-dose registry remain to be reviewed before adding quantitative claims or a separate formulation-specific entry.
No UK authorisation, NHS access, actual supply or clinical approval inferred.
nextAction: Review linked original abstracts and high-dose registry, then propose focused factual catalogue changes with separate populations and endpoints.
